Farsyt is an AI-native insurance services company reimagining how insurance is bought, sold and operated -- using automation, data and AI from the ground up.
Small team, high ownership, fast pace, venture-backed. This role is for someone who wants to take real ownership, move quickly, and build systems that matter.

You’ll work closely with the founders and early engineers to build core product systems from the ground up.
Build and ship backend systems (APIs, services, data models)
Develop AI-powered workflows that replace manual operations
Integrate with external systems (carrier tools, documents, communication layers)
Build automation pipelines using LLMs and modern AI tooling
Work on asynchronous systems (queues, workers, long-running tasks)
Ship quickly — from idea → production in days, not months
You won’t just be handed tickets — you’ll be expected to understand problems deeply and help shape solutions.
Qualifications
1+ years of experience building production systems
Strong backend fundamentals (we use Python)
Comfortable working with APIs, databases, and cloud environments
Ability to learn quickly and operate in a fast-moving environment
Experience or strong interest in modern AI systems (LLMs, RAG, agents)
Solid engineering fundamentals (debugging, data modeling, system design)
Good product instincts — you care about what you’re building and why
Bonus:
Experience with asynchronous systems (Celery, Redis, cron jobs)
Production experience with LLM-based applications or automation workflows
Familiarity with fintech, insurance, or regulated environments
We care more about how you think and learn than the exact tools you’ve used.
Technical Stack
Python (Django/DRF, FastAPI), React/TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, AWS, Gemini/OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, Pydantic AI/LangChain, Docker

You’d be joining the founding technical team, with direct input into what gets built and how. The people who join now will shape the company in ways that won’t be possible later.

You’ll be one of the first engineers — your decisions will shape the company

Competitive salary & equity

description_preview:
This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.
She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.
The next step is to speak to Jack.
Job Title
AI-Native GTM Engineer
Salary
Not Disclosed
Company Description
Fancysauce Inc. is a pre-seed AI-native startup founded by Harvard and Apple alumni (formerly Retain.ai, $30M exit) and backed by Afore Capital and angels from OpenAI and Gemini. The team is building agentic recipes for AI cost management, serving as an intelligent load balancer for the modern enterprise AI stack.
Job Description
As the first AI-Native GTM Engineer at Fancysauce Inc., you will architect the systems powering our revenue engine from scratch. You will build signal-driven outbound machines, automate complex prospecting workflows with AI agents, and own the technical data infrastructure. This is a builder-first role combining engineering rigor with high-growth go-to-market strategy.
Location
San Francisco, USA
Why this role is remarkable
Work directly with a founding team that previously scaled Retain.ai to a $30M acquisition and features leadership with experience scaling revenue from $0 to $100M+.
Own the entire revenue architecture as the first GTM engineer, deploying cutting-edge AI tools like Clay, n8n, and custom AI agents to drive measurable business outcomes.
Join a high-velocity, pre-seed company backed by top-tier investors including Afore Capital and strategic angels from OpenAI, Gemini, and Baseten in a rapidly growing market.
What You Will Do
Architect the "Pipeline Machine" by designing smart, signal-driven nurture sequences and intent-based outbound engines that generate qualified meetings and high-velocity pipeline.
Automate manual GTM workflows using APIs, webhooks, and AI agents to replace repetitive account research, CRM hygiene, and post-call follow-up tasks.
Own end-to-end data integrity by building enrichment waterfalls and sync architectures that ensure our revenue systems remain accurate, deduplicated, and trustworthy.
The ideal candidate
Has 1-3+ years of experience in a technical GTM, SDR/BDR, or engineering role at a fast-paced startup, with a deep understanding of the modern AI toolchain.
Possesses a strong engineering background with the ability to write Python, SQL, or JavaScript to solve complex integration problems when no-code tools fall short.
Thrives in high-ownership, ambiguous environments, operating as a "manager of one" who ships experiments quickly and iterates based on data-driven signals.
Who are Jack & Jill?
Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
How does this work?
Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.
We never post fake jobs
This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

Salesforce / CPQ
